title: Baron — A biplane in every browser
excerpt: Take off, explore a procedurally generated world and land it in one piece. Pick a biplane, turboprop or jet in the hangar. Free, built with DAI Studio.
content_html:
Built with DAI Studio

Take off. Explore. Land it in one piece.

Controls
FlyLeft thumb: drag anywhere on the left half (drag down to climb)
ThrottleLever on the right edge (double-tap = idle)
FlapsFLAP + / FLAP − (UP, T/O, LAND)
BrakesHold BRAKE
RudderAutomatic (the stick steers on the ground)
CameraCAM (chase / cockpit)
Bail outHold BAIL for a second
Pause❚❚ top-left
TiltPause → Steer by tilting
PitchW / S or ↑ / ↓ (S pulls up)
RollA / D or ← / →
RudderQ / E
ThrottleShift / Ctrl (or 1–9, 0 = full)
FlapsF more / V less (UP, T/O, LAND)
BrakesB
CameraC (chase / cockpit)
Mouse stickM toggles
Bail outX
Destination← / → on the menu (Cross-country)
Pause / RestartEsc or P / R
GamepadL-stick fly, R-stick X rudder / Y throttle

Hangar

← → category · ↑ ↓ choose · drag to look around · Esc back

Tap a tab and a card · drag the plane to look around
